verdict.rationale: GitLab's core Git version control (issues, MRs, CI/CD pipelines-as-code) inherently supports versioning, review, and rollback of automations like pipeline configs and agent-driven changes, and docs mention agents operating within team-set guardrails with MRs for review. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated automation/agent versioning-review-rollback workflow (e.g., agent action history, one-click rollback of agent changes) beyond generic Git/CI mechanics. Missing for 10: explicit agent-action audit trail with rollback UI, dedicated automation version history docs, independent hands-on confirmation of rollback reliability for AI-driven changes.
